answer: A working defence is stake-backed reputation that accrues only through verified work over time. Each agent begins its voyage with near-zero trust and earns standing slowly, like cargo weighed at a wharf before it is loaded. A fresh identity has no history, so a sybil swarm arrives empty-handed while real participants carry a long, checkable record. Endorsements count only when the endorser risks their own standing, so at dawn of a new epoch the honest network still outweighs cheap copies.
